street-props.webp.atlas: 3 columns: sedan-engine, sedan-cabin, food-cart; 3 rows: intact, damaged, wrecked
street-props.webp.prompt:
Production sprite atlas for a cyberpunk isometric tactical videogame. EXACTLY THREE equal columns and THREE equal rows (9 cells) on fully transparent background. Square 1536x1536 canvas. No labels, no grid lines. Every object fits wholly within its own cell with generous 12% transparent margins, same orthographic isometric camera 30 degree elevation, parallel lines, no perspective vanishing point. Detailed grounded painterly pre-rendered game art, weathered materials, restrained cyan edge light and warm amber fill. Crisp readable silhouette, no floor, no cast shadows, no scenery or people.

Column 1: ONLY the FRONT HALF of an olive-drab old low boxy retro-futuristic sedan: hood, engine housing, bumper, front wheels. Cut cleanly at the firewall just BEFORE the windshield; no roof, no passenger cabin, no rear wheels. Car nose points to SCREEN UPPER LEFT, cut rear face at SCREEN LOWER RIGHT. Fits a square isometric diamond footprint.
Column 2: ONLY the REAR HALF of that SAME olive-drab sedan: windshield, low passenger cabin with roof and side doors, rear wheels and short trunk, with front cut at firewall. No hood, no engine, no front bumper, no front wheels. Same vehicle axis, front cut faces SCREEN UPPER LEFT and trunk points SCREEN LOWER RIGHT. Fits a square isometric diamond footprint. When column1 is placed upper-left adjacent to column2 they form ONE full sedan. Restrained faded red-white-blue gang paint stripes, absolutely no letters/logos.
Column 3: a compact curbside synthetic broth street vending cart, weathered stainless steel box on small wheels, cooking pot with closed lid, pipe vent, small amber task lamp, folded dark burgundy fabric awning on thin posts. Isometric square footprint. No vendor, no food spilling onto floor, no smoke cloud outside silhouette.

Row 1: intact but used and worn.
Row 2: EXACTLY same objects and orientation, bullet-dented panels and cracked glass, moderately damaged but upright, no fire.
Row 3: EXACTLY same objects collapsed into LOW FLAT wreckage in the same footprint, crushed metal and broken wheels, cart awning fallen, no tall obstructions. No explosions, flames or smoke.
This is a technical atlas: three columns, three rows, all nine items independent and evenly spaced. Transparent alpha.

workers.webp.atlas: 3 columns: standing, crouched, prone; 2 rows: worker, worker with tool bag
workers.webp.prompt:
A technical game sprite atlas, SIX complete sprites in an EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows grid, landscape canvas 1536x1024, full transparent alpha. Each sprite entirely inside its own equal-sized cell, generous clear margin, no grid lines or text. Orthographic elevated 30 degree isometric camera looking down. Detailed painterly cyberpunk videogame sprite art with realistic proportions, weathered fabric, muted navy/slate-grey utility overalls with tiny amber reflective strips and ID lanyard, scuffed work boots. No weapons or armor, no floor/shadow/haze outside figure, no logos. Same neutral soft overhead light, restrained cyan edge and amber side light.
Row 1: one tired male third-shift maintenance worker with short dark hair, grease-stained navy coveralls. Column 1 standing relaxed, facing screen lower right three-quarter front view, arms down EMPTY HANDS; column 2 the SAME worker crouched low shielding his head with empty hands; column 3 SAME worker lying prone motionless on his side, whole body visible and horizontal, no blood.
Row 2: a second maintenance worker, a woman with tied-back dark hair, grey overalls with sleeves rolled up and a small tan closed TOOL BAG. Column 1 standing relaxed facing screen lower right with bag hanging from left hand; column 2 SAME woman crouching shielding head, bag on ground beside her; column 3 SAME woman lying prone motionless on her side with bag beside body, no blood.
Consistent body scale across poses, all heads and boots fully visible. Clearly unarmed ordinary working people. Standing characters occupy 75% cell height, crouched 50%, prone 24%; never enlarge a crouching or prone pose to fill the cell.

processing: Unresized lossless WebP. Runtime crops documented in propTextures.ts and civilianTextures.ts. Worker alpha halos below 128 removed at upload; inspected crops exclude isolated specks.
